release.highlight_1: Profiles now use a stable local ID, nickname, and image avatar; avatars are stored in a platform-reserved bucket and synchronized into sessions.
release.highlight_2: Game SDK Player adds a read-only avatar, and Authority can open the app's existing QR-code and link panel from a valid user action.
release.highlight_3: Online catalogs now support a single publicURL import, source sections, cross-source search aggregation, version updates, and source uploads.
release.highlight_4: Catalog API 2.0 adds latest-only results, versioned downloads, icons, and user-upload declarations, and rejects legacy source and cache formats.
release.highlight_5: Go Server adds user accounts, email verification, upload keys, increasing-version review, icons, and publishing; legacy SQLite schemas are rejected.
release.highlight_6: The UI now has complete Chinese and English resources, consistent theming across windows, responsive mobile layouts, keyboard support, and accessibility semantics.
release.highlight_7: App 3.0.0+23; Game SDK 3.0.0, App Bridge SDK 3.0.0, Go Core 0.5.0, Core protocol 1.3.0, Developer API 2.3.0, and CLI 1.4.0.
release.highlight_8: The floating game tools are now a portrait- and landscape-responsive sidebar. Back opens it without pausing gameplay, while the SDK retains direct game exit.
